semiconductor_relevance: High — Sanyu Co., Ltd specializes in equipment for semiconductor device sample preparation and failure analysis.
summary: Sanyu Co., Ltd provides precision polishing solutions designed for semiconductor device sample preparation, focusing on failure analysis. Their ELLMID system enhances the efficiency of sample preparation by minimizing variations and preserving valuable defective devices, thereby shortening lead times for quality assurance workflows.
capabilities: Localized polishing systems for semiconductor device sample preparation
Failure analysis systems that enable targeted layer exposure
Uniform etching solutions that cancel out nozzle plasma fluctuations
